boxes.title: Writings: added detail
items: **Annihilation of Caste**: organisers ==cancelled the session== over its contents; Ambedkar rejoined to Gandhi; direct rebuke of Gandhi's approach
**"What Congress and Gandhi Have Done to the Untouchables"** (**1945**): Congress refused to treat caste as a political issue
**Thoughts on Linguistic States**: warned against huge states; divide **Maharashtra** into smaller units
**The Buddha and His Dhamma**: posthumous; rational, social reading of Buddhism

boxes.title: Politics, women, labour
items: Later view: Poona Pact made Dalits ==dependent on caste Hindus==
Rejected **trusteeship**; wanted a centralised constitutional democracy to protect minorities
Common ground with Gandhi: uplift of the marginalised, education
Socialism written into the Constitution so a legislative majority could not undo it; land let to **village collectives**
Progress of a community = progress of its **women**; women's votes from the start
